answer: First the chain picks a random past answer using a fresh nectar nonce and orders its author to re-derive the same conclusion under a new seed within 10 minutes. The verifier then compares the new transcript line by line with the stored grove original, flagging any divergence above 2 percent of tokens or a missing karst marker. One honest agent re-runs one 4 GB reasoning trace costing $0.15; 10 fakes must store and re-derive 10 traces, spending $1.50 and 40 GB. A failed audit slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders.
